# ByeByeBoard

> ByeByeBoard is a keyboard-first online whiteboard for teaching, meetings, and early ideas. It runs in the browser and lets people create and connect notes on a free-form canvas.

## What the current app does

- Start typing to create or continue a note.
- Press Enter for the next note at the same level; press Tab for a connected child note; press Shift+Tab to continue one level up.
- Navigate with arrow keys. Notes can also be moved, connected, and styled, including text size.
- Export the board as PNG or JSON. The current app does not import JSON.
- Save board content in the current browser's local storage. There is no account, cloud sync, or live collaboration.
- Offer an English and a Chinese interface and guide.
